title: Apple's Craig Federighi says some companies "appear to be racing forward" to develop "AI for the sake of AI" without regard for the humans using the technology (Todd Spangler/Variety)
summary: Todd Spangler / Variety: Apple's Craig Federighi says some companies “appear to be racing forward” to develop “AI for the sake of AI” without regard for the humans using the technology — Apple said it has rebuilt the Siri personal assistant from the ground up with artificial intelligence at its core …
contentText:
Todd Spangler / Variety :

Apple's Craig Federighi says some companies “appear to be racing forward” to develop “AI for the sake of AI” without regard for the humans using the technology   —  Apple said it has rebuilt the Siri personal assistant from the ground up with artificial intelligence at its core …
